backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Principal collateral ratio: (free USDC + sum of strategy assetsUnderManagement) / pool.totalAssets(). Three INDEPENDENT contract reads, so ~100% is the vault's components agreeing with its own accounting, not an identity — a shortfall would show. ⚠️ total_supply is denominated in SHARES: total_backing/total_supply is assets-per-share (a NAV, ~1.18) and NOT a coverage ratio. The two figures answer different questions.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: pool.totalAssets() minus its independently-read components — the reconciliation residual, currently a few dollars on a book of hundreds of millions. NOT backing minus supply, which would be meaningless here because supply is in shares.
